author: Kuhn & Rueß GmbH
description: Ping targets from a Windows host. The agent bakery rule "Windows Ping" deploys windows_ping.ps1 together with the list of targets (IP address or host name, optional display name), the number of echo requests, the timeout and levels for round trip time and packet loss. The plug-in pings all targets concurrently and creates one local service per target with rta and pl metrics. The MRPE/Nagios compatible check_ping.ps1 with its check_ping.cmd wrapper is still shipped for single targets via "Deploy custom files with the agent".
name: windows_ping
title: Windows Ping (agent bakery and MRPE)
